===Crowbar===
{{Needed|[[Steel bar]], [[hammer]], [[redberry pie]], [[combat equipment]].}}
{{Checklist|
*Head south of the Port Sarim docks and talk to [[Thurgo]]. {{Chat option|3 I need some help with a 'special key'.|1 Yes.}} or {{Chat option|4 I need some help with a 'special key'.|1 Yes.}} depending on if [[Below Ice Mountain]] has been completed.
**[[Fairy ring]] {{Fairycode|AIQ}} is closest to Thurgo; you can return to Pandemonium via [[Captain Tobias]] from Port Sarim (30 coins).
*Head back to Steve. {{Chat option|3 I made that 'special key' you needed.}}
*Sail to the north-western island of Pandemonium to find a floating [[sealed crate]].
**Take the crowbar from your cargo hold and pry open the crate.
*Drink the [[bottle of fish bladder stout]]. {{Chat option|1 Yes.}}
**Defeat or disembark from the [[drink troll]] that spawns on the boat.
*Return to Steve. {{Chat option|3 About that crate...}}
*Open the [[sealed crate]] behind Steve with the [[crowbar]].
*'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''
}}
